name: Pirate

feature.name: Bad Reputation
desc: No matter where you go, people are afraid of you due to your reputation. When you are in a civilized settlement, you can get away with minor criminal offenses, such as refusing to pay for food at a tavern or breaking down doors at a local shop, since most people will not report your activity to the authorities for fear of your reprisal.

traits: My friends know they can rely on me.
I work hard so that I can play hard.
I enjoy sailing into new ports.
I stretch the truth for the sake of a good story.
To me, a tavern brawl is a nice way to get to know a new city.
I never pass up a friendly wager.
My language is as foul as an otyugh's nest.
I like a job well done.
ideals: Respect. Mutual respect between captain and crew. (Good)
Fairness. We all do the work, so we all share in the rewards. (Lawful)
Mastery. I'm a master of my craft. (Any)
People. I'm committed to my crewmates. (Neutral)
Aspiration. Someday I'll own my own ship. (Any)
bonds: I'm loyal to my captain first.
The ship is my home and the crew are my family.
I'll always remember my first ship.
In a harbor town, I have a paramour.
I was cheated out of my fair share of the profits.
Ruthless pirates murdered my captain and crewmate.
flaws: I follow orders, even if I think they're wrong.
I'll say anything to avoid extra work.
Once I start drinking, it's hard for me to stop.
I can't help but pocket anything that looks valuable.
My pride will probably lead to my destruction.
I'll wait until my comrades are asleep to steal their shares.

desc: You spent years as a pirate, sailing the high seas and raiding ships. You are known for your ruthlessness and your bad reputation, which can be a useful tool when dealing with those who would rather avoid a fight. You're far closer than most people to the world of murder, theft, and violence.
